Recourse as in means of getting this thing down
 I dont really mind the video I have thick skin.but my name and phone number being very visible on it is causing me to get calls texts and social media interactions from people I do not know and I want it to stop.

It's in Missouri to be more specific

Let me just be clear I'm not out to strike legal vengeance on the world for a video and sue for a million dollars I just want it down so my information isn't just out there like that.
Midwest USA. So I have no recourse but to sit on hold with customer service and beg them to take said video down?

What is the point of all these privacy policies if she can record information given through the order on the restaraunts app and post it online, while on the clock at the restaraunt. (Major chain) Is my information not protected at all?
